shelters.name: Alaska SPCA
shelters.description: Independent local nonprofit promoting animal welfare since 1955. Provides affordable veterinary services, adoption center, pet food bank, and mobile surgery unit.

shelters.name: Anchorage Animal Care and Control
shelters.description: Open-admission municipal shelter serving the entire Municipality of Anchorage. Promotes public health, safety, responsible pet ownership, and humane care of animals.

shelters.name: Juneau Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Private nonprofit shelter founded in 1963, serving domestic animals in Juneau for over 60 years. The largest shelter in Southeast Alaska, operating as an open-admission facility.

shelters.name: Fairbanks North Star Borough Animal Control
shelters.description: Municipal animal shelter serving Fairbanks North Star Borough, providing animal control services and pet adoptions.

shelters.name: Mat-Su Borough Animal Care and Regulation
shelters.description: Dedicated to serving the Alaskan community and animals in need. Maintains shelter and enforcement services for Mat-Su Borough including Palmer and Wasilla.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Kodiak
shelters.description: Operating the only animal shelter in the Kodiak Archipelago since 1995. A no-kill shelter for friendly adoptable pets, committed to preventing animal cruelty and reducing homeless pets.

shelters.name: Ketchikan Humane Society
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) formed in 2001 to help abused and abandoned animals in Southern Southeast Alaska find permanent homes and reduce unwanted animals through low-cost spay/neuter services.

shelters.name: Kenai Animal Shelter
shelters.description: City shelter promoting community safety through public education, spaying/neutering, and humane operations. All animals are spayed/neutered and microchipped before adoption.

shelters.name: Kenai Peninsula Animal Lovers Rescue
shelters.description: Founded in 2019, provides safe environment for stray, surrendered, abused, or abandoned animals through foster network with goal of finding forever homes.

shelters.name: Friends of Sitka Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Dedicated to providing quality care and shelter to animals in need while offering services, resources, and education to community members.

shelters.name: Alaska Mindful Paws
shelters.description: Non-profit organization in Homer dedicated to providing shelter, care and advocacy to homeless animals in the community.

shelters.name: Alaskan Animal Rescue Friends
shelters.description: All-volunteer, foster home based dog rescue. Takes dogs from bush communities, local animal control, owner releases, and neglect cases.

shelters.name: Friends of Pets
shelters.description: Established in 1989, 100% volunteer organization rescuing at least 80% of animals from Anchorage Animal Care & Control. Places 100-150 animals per year.

shelters.name: Alaska Dog and Puppy Rescue
shelters.description: All-volunteer organization helping meet the needs of the Mat-Su Valley pet overpopulation problem, rescuing weekly from Mat-Su Borough Animal Shelter and Houston Animal Control.

shelters.name: Second Chance League
shelters.description: Group of Fairbanks mushers focused on finding permanent homes for sled dogs. Works exclusively with dogs from municipal shelter, evaluating, fostering, and training them.

shelters.name: Alaska Humane Society
shelters.description: Founded in 1979, operates a no-kill shelter and sanctuary for orphan cats in Anchorage.

shelters.name: Best Friends Animal Rescue Alaska
shelters.description: Registered 501(c)3 non-profit helping families from all over Alaska find their next best friend through adoption services.

shelters.name: Forget-Me-Not Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization in North Pole, Alaska founded in 2023, dedicated to rescuing and rehoming animals in the Fairbanks area.

shelters.name: Golden Retriever Rescue of Fairbanks
shelters.description: Breed-specific rescue organization dedicated to rescuing and rehoming Golden Retrievers in the Fairbanks area.

shelters.name: Loving Companions Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving the Fairbanks area, dedicated to finding loving homes for companion animals.

shelters.name: HARK - Haines Animal Rescue Kennel
shelters.description: Finds homes for homeless animals, offers low-cost medical services, educates the public on responsible pet care, and serves as animal control in Haines.

shelters.name: Bering Sea Humane Society
shelters.description: Animal welfare organization in Nome, Alaska founded in 2020 serving the remote Bering Sea region.

shelters.name: Petersburg Humane Association
shelters.description: Animal shelter organization in Petersburg, Alaska founded in 2008 serving the local community.

shelters.name: Helping Escaped and Lost Pets
shelters.description: Nonprofit helping return lost pets home in the Mat-Su Valley, including Palmer, Wasilla, and all of the Mat-Su Borough.

shelters.name: Companions Inc
shelters.description: Pet support volunteers organization serving the Fairbanks area with various animal welfare programs.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Alaska animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Alaska's unique geography means many communities are served by small local rescues. Major population centers (Anchorage, Fairbanks, Juneau) have larger shelter operations. Many rescue organizations work with bush communities to transport animals to areas with more adoption opportunities.
